title: Apocalyptic Mechanical Eye
description: A massive mechanical eye with gears and metal casing floats at the center of a blazing red-orange fiery portal in a dark stormy sky. The barren cracked desert below is littered with floating colorful orbs, dripping paint-like elements, and broken glass, while ghostly screaming faces emerge from the turbulent clouds above jagged mountains.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a giant intricate mechanical eye with gears and metal details floating at the center of a massive blazing red and orange circular fiery portal. Dark stormy sky filled with screaming ghostly faces and swirling clouds. Barren cracked desert ground with jagged mountains in the background. Numerous colorful spheres and dripping yellow and green liquid elements float throughout the composition, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
